programmes.d: Mr. Bean hopes to win some cash prizes at the funfair, but it’s not as easy as it seems! Mr. Bean goes to his favourite china shop to buy a new cup for Teddy, but when he opens his wallet he doesn’t have enough money to pay for it.

Mr. Bean’s electricity is cut off so he builds a wind turbine – all fine until there’s too much wind! Mr. Bean’s electricity supply is cut off when Mrs. Wicket sees the cost of her enormous electricity bill.
When a disgruntled employee steals an ancient Dragon Flute from a Toronto Museum, he uses its legendary powers to render crowds of people unconscious.
When a lucky coin is stolen from the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, it triggers a market crash, threatening even the vast wealth of the Ripley fortune.
Lycanthrope terrorists take over an exclusive country club, and Blaze and Logan must descend to an underground, cold war missile base to investigate...
Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding...
A dolphin at Sea World will only eat from Cleo’s hand and when she has to sneak out to feed him, everyone thinks she has a boyfriend.
A rainy day traps the girls inside. In an effort to play sick, the girls create a situation where their families become part of a dire medical emergency.
The full moon has come again, and the girls are taking every precaution they can imagine this time. It proves to be in vain, however, when Rikki falls under the spell.

Cleo and Kim are fighting like crazy and Cleo is pushed to breaking point. Then cousin Angela comes to stay and things just get worse. Cleo realises there are more challenging things than an annoying sister.
Lewis enters the annual fishing derby. When Cleo sees him struggling, she decides to help him out with disastorous consequnces. Meanwhile, Rikki and Zane are trapped on a hotel balcony.

Zane thinks Miss Chatham holds the key to the sea monster. Emma needs a change so dyes her hair red. While Zane gets closer to the secret, he also gets closer to Rikki. Zane dives to Miss Chatham’s boat and sees a mermaid!

Emma and Cleo find out Zane and Rikki are an item and force her to choose – him or them. When Zane appears to side with Harrison over the Mako island development Rikki’s decision is clear. Now it’s Zane’s turn to make a choice…
In a rematch, Zyro uses Synchrome to combine his bey Ifrit with Shinobu's bey Salamander to defeat the Unabara brothers' bey Orochi Leviathan.
Benkei continues to train Bladers, with Kite, Eight, and Ren joining Shinobu, and Zyro.
While on a beach vacation, Zyro and the others solve a mystery about a supposed Sea Monster.
Zyro and his friends are sent by the WBBA to show bladers around the world how much fun beyblading in the new Cyclone Beystadium can be.
Shinobu Hiryuin and his Ninja Salamander are defeated by Sakyo Kurayami and his Ronin Dragoon.
A Blader named Yoshio Iwayama comes to town and defeats both Eight and Kite Unabara.
Sabrina is psyched about school dance and can't understand why Harvey doesn't want to go.
Salem falls for a fellow feline. He learns that she is a kittywitch as well. They fall in love and want to run off together.
Harvey lacks the courage to show his comic book to the great comic book creator, King Kirby. Sabrina decides to give Harvey a wishing star in hopes that he'll wish for courage.
The Student of the Year winner will be announced soon and Sabrina and Gem are tied to win. Gem uses her money to win the contest so Sabrina uses magic to make Gem lose.
Sabrina, desperate to earn money for an upcoming concert, baby sits the terror twins. Hilda, Zelda and Uncle Quigley warn her that she's just not ready but Sabrina is adamant.
When a sunken treasure is found off the coast of Riverdale, Reggie succumbs to the greedy curse of the pirate's gold.
Spooky and mysterious things are happening at Riverdale High.
Dr. Arachnid, an evil supervillain, has come to Riverdale to commit some dastardly deeds.

programmes.d: Cleo seeks a new job as an assistant dolphin trainer at the Marine Park. Rikki fires Nate's band from playing at the cafe until she and Bella reach an understanding.

programmes.d: Cleo is forced to put Lewis' plans for romance on hold to restrain Kim's out-of-control love life. During this time, Don meets Samantha, a National Parks manager, and they start dating.

programmes.d: Zane concocts a dirt bike race to publicize the café. When Rikki discovers it's a scam, she and Bella decide to teach him and Nate a lesson. Cleo and Lewis make a major discovery about mixing the waters in the Moon Pool.

Marshall is love's reluctant mail carrier when the ghost of a 1920s smitten teen demands that Marshall delivers a love letter to the spirit's dreamgirl, now an elderly woman.
Junior High School friends Stephanie and Jan hate rules.
Evan Wagner will do anything to get out of doing his homework, including lie to his teacher.

UBOS is acting weird and dizzy as the kids learn he's becoming UNGLUED, literally! The Book is losing its binding and can only be rebound by the magical BOOKBINDING GNOMES who've been captured by Zarlak and taken deep into the Centre of the Earth.
